usage: Treatment of susceptible bacterial infections, including selected ear, nose and throat, respiratory, skin and genitourinary infections; also used in specific combination regimens for Helicobacter pylori.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash; serious risks include severe allergic reactions and Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including some sinus, ear, respiratory, skin and urinary infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions, C. difficile-associated diarrhoea and liver injury.

usage: Treatment of infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including selected respiratory, gastrointestinal, urinary and other infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions, severe skin reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain respiratory, skin and sexually transmitted infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain; serious risks include QT prolongation/abnormal heart rhythm, liver injury and severe allergic or skin reactions.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including respiratory and skin infections; also used in combination regimens for H. pylori.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain, altered taste; serious risks include QT prolongation, liver injury, severe allergic reactions and important drug interactions.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by susceptible bacteria; specific uses depend on formulation and indication.
symptoms: Nausea, abdominal cramps, vomiting, diarrhoea; serious risks include QT prolongation/arrhythmias, liver injury and allergic reactions.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain respiratory, skin, tick-borne and sexually transmitted infections; also used for malaria prevention in specified circumstances.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, photosensitivity, oesophageal irritation; serious risks include severe allergic/skin reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections; some formulations are used for acne or specific skin conditions.
symptoms: Dizziness/vertigo, nausea, diarrhoea, skin or tooth pigmentation; serious risks include liver injury, severe skin reactions and drug-induced autoimmune reactions.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by tetracycline-susceptible bacteria; use depends on organism and clinical indication.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, photosensitivity; serious risks include severe allergic reactions and effects on developing teeth/bone in certain age groups.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible skin and soft-tissue, respiratory, bone and genitourinary infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible skin/soft-tissue, throat and urinary tract infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible infections, including certain respiratory, ear, skin and urinary tract infections; formulations have different approved uses.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible infections, including certain respiratory, ear and skin infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, headache, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including certain urinary, ear, throat and respiratory infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, abdominal discomfort, nausea, loose stools; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible respiratory, skin and urinary tract infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, rash; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of serious or selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain respiratory, bloodstream, abdominal, urinary, skin, bone/joint and meningitis infections.
symptoms: Injection-site pain, diarrhoea, rash, changes in blood counts; serious risks include allergic reactions, biliary complications and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, commonly in perioperative prevention and certain skin, bone, joint and other infections.
symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash or injection-site reactions; serious risks include allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected moderate-to-severe infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including certain pneumonia, urinary, skin and intra-abdominal infections when used with appropriate companion therapy.
symptoms: Rash, diarrhoea, nausea, fever; serious risks include neurotoxicity (especially with impaired kidney function), allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including certain intra-abdominal, skin, pelvic and hospital-acquired pneumonia infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, rash, headache; serious risks include allergic reactions, kidney-related concerns in some combinations, blood-count changes and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including complicated intra-abdominal infections, meningitis in indicated patients and certain skin infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, headache, rash or infusion-site reactions; serious risks include seizures (risk increased in some patients), allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including certain intra-abdominal, lower respiratory, urinary, skin and gynaecological infections.
symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash; serious risks include seizures, allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by susceptible bacteria; use is restricted for some uncomplicated infections when safer alternatives are suitable.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, abdominal discomfort, headache; serious risks include tendon injury/rupture, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects, QT prolongation and worsening of myasthenia gravis.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain pneumonia, sinus, urinary and skin infections; reserve for some conditions when alternatives are appropriate.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, headache, insomnia; serious risks include tendon injury, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects, QT prolongation and worsening of myasthenia gravis.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain respiratory and skin infections; not suitable for every infection site.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, dizziness; serious risks include QT prolongation, tendon injury, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects and worsening of myasthenia gravis.

usage: Treatment of selected susceptible bacterial infections, including certain urinary infections and other specifically indicated infections.
symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, rash; serious risks include severe skin reactions, blood disorders, kidney effects, high potassium and allergic reactions.

usage: Treatment of susceptible uncomplicated lower urinary tract infections; not appropriate for kidney infection or systemic infection.
symptoms: Nausea, reduced appetite, headache; urine may darken. Serious risks include lung reactions, liver injury, peripheral neuropathy and haemolysis in susceptible patients.

usage: Treatment of uncomplicated urinary tract infection in specified patients and formulations.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, headache, vaginitis; serious allergic reactions and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea are possible.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by susceptible anaerobic bacteria and certain protozoa; indication depends on the infection.
symptoms: Nausea, metallic taste, abdominal discomfort, headache; serious risks include peripheral neuropathy with certain exposure patterns, seizures/encephalopathy rarely and severe skin reactions.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including certain anaerobic, skin, soft-tissue and bone infections.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain, rash; major serious risk is C. difficile-associated colitis, which can be severe.

usage: Treatment of selected infections caused by susceptible Gram-positive bacteria, including certain resistant infections such as MRSA and VRE, according to indication.
symptoms: Diarrhoea, nausea, headache, vomiting; serious risks include low blood counts, serotonin syndrome with interacting medicines, optic/peripheral neuropathy with prolonged use and lactic acidosis.

usage: Treatment depends on route: oral vancomycin is used for certain intestinal infections; intravenous vancomycin is used for selected serious Gram-positive infections.
symptoms: Oral use may cause nausea or abdominal discomfort; IV use may cause infusion reactions. Serious risks include kidney injury, hearing-related toxicity in some circumstances and severe hypersensitivity.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, usually with specialist oversight and monitoring.
symptoms: Nausea or injection-site effects may occur; serious risks include kidney injury, hearing/balance damage and neuromuscular effects.

usage: Treatment of selected serious infections caused by susceptible bacteria, usually with specialist oversight and monitoring.
symptoms: Nausea or injection-site effects may occur; serious risks include kidney injury, hearing/balance damage and neuromuscular effects.

usage: Treatment of selected serious susceptible bacterial infections; inhaled and ophthalmic formulations have specific uses.
symptoms: Depending on route, cough or airway irritation, nausea, or eye irritation may occur; systemic exposure can cause kidney injury and hearing/balance damage.

usage: Used in specific regimens for tuberculosis and certain other infections; usually combined with other medicines when treating tuberculosis.
symptoms: Nausea, abdominal discomfort, orange-red discoloration of urine/tears/sweat; serious risks include liver injury, severe allergic reactions and many drug interactions.

usage: Treatment of selected intestinal conditions, including certain non-invasive diarrhoea caused by susceptible E. coli, and other specific gastrointestinal indications.
symptoms: Nausea, abdominal pain, headache; serious risks include hypersensitivity and C. difficile-associated diarrhoea.

usage: Reserved for selected serious infections when safer effective alternatives are unsuitable; use varies by formulation and local guidance.
symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea; serious risks include bone-marrow suppression and rare, potentially fatal aplastic anaemia.

usage: Reserved for selected serious infections caused by susceptible multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria, with specialist oversight.
symptoms: Numbness/tingling, dizziness or gastrointestinal effects may occur; serious risks include kidney injury and neuromuscular toxicity.

usage: Treatment of selected serious Gram-positive infections, including certain skin infections and bloodstream/right-sided endocarditis; not indicated for pneumonia.
symptoms: Nausea, diarrhoea, headache, injection-site reactions; serious risks include muscle injury/rhabdomyolysis and eosinophilic pneumonia.

usage: Treatment of selected complicated skin/soft-tissue and intra-abdominal infections, and certain community-acquired pneumonia cases; use depends on indication and alternatives.
symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea; serious risks include liver/pancreatic effects, pancreatitis and an FDA boxed warning regarding increased all-cause mortality in pooled trials.
